title: This Digger Weighs 14,000 Tons and Stands 310 Feet Tall

scenes.text: This digger weighs 14,000 tons and stands 310 feet tall.
It's called Bagger 293, a bucket-wheel excavator built in Germany.
Its wheel is 71 feet across, carrying 18 giant buckets.
It can move 240,000 cubic meters of earth every day, enough to fill about 96 Olympic pools.
Yet its top speed is just 10 meters a minute.
The heaviest land vehicle ever built moves slower than you walk.

description:
Bagger 293 is a bucket-wheel excavator that weighs about 14,200 metric tons and stands about 310 feet tall.
It can move 240,000 cubic meters of earth a day.
How big is the biggest machine you have ever seen?
first_comment: What is the biggest machine you have ever seen in person?
